2)    About the Role

ESN is looking for a Finance officer with an accounting background to join our Secretariat in Brussels on a part-time basis (60%).

Working under the supervision of the Finance Manager, the Finance officer will support the financial operations and accounting systems that ensure the smooth running of the ESN Secretariat. The role involves regular collaboration with our external accounting provider, particularly around monthly closings, quarterly VAT declarations and the annual audit

The position offers a broad exposure to non-profit accounting and European funding procedures.
 
3)    Key Responsibilities

a)    Accounts payable & receivable

¿    Process supplier invoices, staff reimbursements, and follow up on customers.
¿    Follow up on outstanding items, supplier payments, direct debits, resolving discrepancies as required.
¿    Record and verify invoices in Clearfacts / WinBooks.
¿    Maintain accurate and updated tracking of accounts receivable / payable ageing reports.

b)    Financial administration & documentation

¿    Maintain accurate accounting records and support document filing.
¿    Prepare regular expense reports.
¿    Reconcile monthly credit cards statements.
¿    Assist in maintaining accounting files ready for audit.
¿    Provide support with other financial and administrative tasks as required.

c)    Banking & treasury

¿    Reconcile bank statements with accounting records (purchase and sales invoices).
¿    Prepare and execute payments in line with internal procedures.
¿    Monitor cash balances and support the Finance & HR Manager in monitoring ESN's liquidity position.

d)    Month- & Year-end closings

¿    Support monthly and annual closing procedures.
¿    Assist with journal entries, accruals, prepayments and account reconciliations.
¿    Contribute to the preparation of periodic and annual financial statements.
¿    Support the year-end closing process and preparation for the annual audit.

e)    Tax, compliance & internal controls

¿    Assist the external accountant with quarterly VAT declarations and other tax submissions.
¿    Support compliance with financial regulations, internal procedures, and external audit requirements.
¿    Ensure accurate documentation in line with Belgian accounting standards.

This list of duties is not exhaustive, and other duties may be required commensurate with the role.

4)    Qualifications

a)    Education & experience

¿    Degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Finance or a related field.
¿    1-3 years of relevant professional experience in a non-profit organisation (a.s.b.l.)

b)    Communication & interpersonal

¿    Excellent written and spoken English, ESN's working language.
¿    Fluency in French is essential for communication with Belgian authorities.
¿    Knowledge of other European languages is an asset.
¿    Strong interpersonal skills and collaborative mindset.

c)    Organisational & professional

¿    Strong time-management skills and ability to meet deadlines.
¿    Ability to work independently with initiative and reliability.
¿    Familiarity with accounting software such as Winbooks (or similar), ClearFacts and Billit.
¿    Ability to prioritise a varied workload in a structured and efficient manner.
¿    High levels of autonomy, integrity, professionalism, and confidentiality.
¿    Proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
¿    Experience with CRM systems and membership-based organisations is an asset.
 
5)    What we offer

¿    A part-time one-year contract (60%), renewable and with the possibility of conversion to a permanent following a performance assessment.
¿    A friendly, multidisciplinary, and multicultural working environment.
¿    A competitive remuneration package, including: 
o    Salary commensurate with experience and role.
o    Double holiday pay and year-end salary.
o    Lunch vouchers, transportation allowance, Internet allowance, laptop, medical insurance (including hospitalisation, consultations, and medication), and eco-vouchers.
o    Additional annual leave, seniority leave and Christmas.
¿    Opportunities for professional development.

I-The role
Based in our Brussels office, you will work in close, direct collaboration with the Global Director of Brand & Digital Marketing and the wider international Marketing team, to ensure the consistency, quality and visibility of digital content across our hotels' distribution and booking platforms. As the central point of contact for content moderation group-wide, you will safeguard the brand's online image, editorial and legal compliance, and user experience across all of the collection's websites. This role offers an excellent opportunity to work at the heart of international hotel digital marketing, online distribution platforms, and content optimization for search engines and AI-powered tools.

II-Key responsibilities

A.Collection knowledge
-Develop an in-depth understanding of the hotels in the collection, their positioning and unique features.
-Become fully familiar with the group's brand standards and digital ecosystem.

B.Digital content audits
-Conduct detailed audits of content across the official website, booking engine, OTAs (Booking.com, Expedia, etc.), Google Business Profile, B2B/MICE platforms (Cvent) and other partner platforms.

C.Content harmonization and updates
-Ensure consistency of information across platforms: hotel descriptions, room categories and names, amenities and services, visual content and photo libraries, editorial tone and brand image.
-Continuously update and optimize content.

D.Search engine and AI model (LLM) optimization
-Optimize content structure and markup (structured data, schema.org, llms.txt files, FAQ content, etc.) to maximize visibility and accuracy across search engines and generative AI tools (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Copilot, etc.).
-Regularly audit how the collection's hotels are represented in AI-generated answers, identify gaps or inaccurate information, and coordinate corrections.
-Support the improvement of quality and standardization of hotel data to help AI systems interpret it correctly.

E.Monitoring and continuous improvement in generative AI
-Actively track the fast-moving evolution of large language models (LLMs) and AI-powered search tools, along with emerging best practices (GEO ¿ Generative Engine Optimization, AEO ¿ Answer Engine Optimization).
-Translate this ongoing monitoring into concrete recommendations and continuously adjust content strategy as algorithms and tools evolve.
-Share learnings and best practices with the Marketing team and other stakeholders across the group. F.Liaison with the collection's hotels
-Act as the main point of contact for hotel properties' local teams for the collection, validation and regular updating of their content (information, photos, offers, events).
-Maintain regular follow-up with each property to ensure responsiveness, reliability and freshness of content across all platforms.

G.Content moderation and quality control
-Moderate, review and approve all content published on the collection's hotel websites prior to going live.
-Ensure compliance with editorial guidelines, brand standards, legal requirements and accessibility norms across all platforms.
 

H.Technical and cross-functional coordination
-Work with IT/web development teams, hotel properties and external agencies to resolve technical issues (broken links, outdated pages, faulty forms).
-Coordinate translation and localization of content across the collection's markets and languages.
-Manage a publishing calendar and prioritize update requests coming from individual properties.

I.Monitoring, reporting and continuous improvement
-Provide regular reporting on content quality, compliance and performance (KPIs, dashboards).
-Stay current on best practices in content moderation, SEO and user experience.
 
-Degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Communications, Hospitality Management or a related field.
-First experience in web content management or moderation, ideally within the hospitality, travel, or a multi-site environment.
-Experience with one or more CMS platforms (WordPress or equivalent) and web analytics tools (Google Analytics, Search Console).
-Excellent attention to detail, rigor, and a strong sense of editorial and legal compliance.
-Genuine interest in the hospitality industry and digital environments.
-Strong analytical and coordination skills, comfortable managing multiple priorities across a multi-market environment.
-Proficiency with digital platforms and content management tools.
-Genuine curiosity about generative AI technologies (LLMs) and their impact on digital discoverability; willingness to continuously learn in this fast-evolving field.
-Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, comfortable liaising with multiple stakeholders (hotels, internal teams, external partners).
-Excellent written and spoken French and English; any additional language is an asset.
 
Type: Sales and Marketing

Localisation: Bruxelles

Type de contrat: CDI

Contrat: Temps plein

Expérience: Moins d'1 an

Langue(s): Français, Anglais

Our client, based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology company bringing the innovative cell therapy to Ghent. With this, the team makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.
They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

For our client, a biotech company that is a fast-growing & innovative organization, we are looking for a warehouse associate.

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.

As a warehouse associate your responsibilities are; 
	
• Receiving biohazard products (blood bags, viral vectors, …) in a controlled temperature environment.	
• Accurately process inventory receipts ensuring correct matching to purchase orders, documentation of approvals, quality checks and adherence to policies. 	
• Working with equipment and material stored at cryogenic 	
• Fill out the Master Inspection Checks (MIC) for incoming materials including: transport unloading, temperature control, integrity control, administrative paperwork related to following correct procedures. 	
• Fill in forms & logbooks related to receiving, picking and outbound activities to comply with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Good Documentation Practices (GDP) policies in the pharmaceutical environment. 	
• Work closely together with the Operations and Quality department to support the Production and Lab activities for our start-up site.  	
• Work in a clean environment where you will wear dedicated gowning clothes. 	
• Working in two SAP Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems to process inbound, picking and outbound activities. 	
• Collaborate with accounting, suppliers and business stakeholders in support of on-going operational efficiency efforts.

	
• Associate’s degree or High-School Diploma. 	
• You have relevant warehouse experience with a strong affinity to the pharmaceutical environment. 	
•  Detail oriented character with a strong affinity to perform administrative work, fill out forms, logbooks, follow regular trainings. 	
• You have an ability to interact and communicate effectively at all levels of the organization and across different functions. 	
• You are a problem solver and have strong analytical and data skills.	
• You follow the procedures strictly to ensure both product quality and personal health & safety are followed at all times. 	
• Ability to work independently and successfully.	
• You speak very good English or Dutch.

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.

Receiving biohazard products (blood bags, viral vectors, …) in a controlled temperature environment.

Accurately process inventory receipts ensuring correct matching to purchase orders, documentation of approvals, quality checks and adherence to policies.

Fill in forms & logbooks related to receiving, picking and outbound activities to comply with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Good Documentation Practices (GDP) policies in the pharmaceutical environment.

Work in a clean environment where you will wear dedicated gowning clothes.

Collaborate with accounting, suppliers and business stakeholders in support of on-going operational efficiency efforts.

At Legend Biotech in Zwijnaarde, you will have the opportunity to participate in the production of advanced CAR-T cell therapies, an innovative form of cancer treatment. You will work in a highly technological GMP-regulated environment.
	
• Working daily in a Class A/B/C/D cleanroom environment	
• Ensuring the cleanliness of equipment and production areas
Performing various steps within the CAR-T manufacturing process, including:

• Cell selection, activation, and transduction	
• Cell culture

You are a detail-oriented team player who enjoys working in an innovative manufacturing environment.

You have:

jobs.description:
The Relationship Support Associate (Corporate Banking) role involves supporting corporate banking processes with precision and efficiency. This position requires a strong command of English and attention to detail to ensure effective operations.

Client Details

The company operates in the financial services industry and is located in Brussels.

Description

As a Relationship Support Associate (Corporate Banking), your responsibilities are:

• Manage and process corporate banking transactions accurately and on time.
• Ensure compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements.
• Collaborate with internal teams to resolve operational issues effectively.
• Monitor and report on operational performance metrics.
• Support the implementation of process improvements to enhance efficiency.
• Maintain accurate records and documentation for all transactions.
• Assist in the preparation of operational reports and analyses.
• Provide support for audits and other compliance activities.Relationship Support Associate (Corporate Banking)

A successful Relationship Support Associate (Corporate Banking) should have:

• A strong command of English, both written and spoken.
• Bachelor or Master degree, preferably in finance or similar.
• Experience or knowledge in the financial services industry.
• Proficiency in using banking systems and tools.
• The ability to work collaboratively with internal teams.
• A commitment to maintaining compliance and operational accuracy.
• Applicants must already be based in Belgium and possess valid authorization to work in Belgium at the time of application.

The Account Manager is responsible for building and maintaining strong, long-term client relationships while actively driving business growth. Beyond managing existing accounts, the role places a strong emphasis on proactive client development, including prospection within the existing portfolio, cross-selling, and identifying new revenue opportunities. The Account Manager acts as both a trusted advisor and a commercial driver, combining relationship management with strong sales, negotiation, and business development skills.
 

 
• Develop and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with assigned clients.
 
• Ensure timely and successful delivery of solutions according to client needs and objectives, and this is within the existing HighCo DATA services package.
 
• Conduct regular business reviews with clients to assess performance and identify opportunities. 

 
• Strong sales and negotiation skills
 
• Excellent interpersonal and communication abilities in French, Dutch and English
 
• Customer-centric mindset with strong business acumen
 
• Ability to identify and convert opportunities into revenue
 
• Proactive and results-oriented approach
 
• Strong organizational and time management skills
 
• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
 
• Team collaboration and cross-functional coordination
 
• Highly driven with a strong commercial mindset
 
• Results-oriented with a focus on growth and performance

What you will do
 
 

• Operate and monitor high-tech automated machines to ensure uninterrupted production. 

• Maintain accurate performance and efficiency of the tools as qualified user. 

• Follow and understand procedures, instructions and WoW quickly and apply them correctly. 

• Able to act correctly and clearly under pressure and ask support when needed.  

• Quickly identify and report any issues or malfunctions to First Line Support (FLS) or WIP lead. 

• Follow safety and operational procedures to maintain a secure and efficient work environment. 

• Communicate in clear language and understandable terms (also in English) and participate actively in shift handover.  

• Keep everything tidy according to 5S rules. 

• Refill chemicals. 

Who you are
 
 

• Experience in operations environment or a similar field is preferred, but we focus on potential. 

• Strong organizational and multitasking skills. 

• Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively. 

• Good communication and teamwork skills. 

• Proactive, detail-oriented and dynamic. 

• Knowledge of English  

Below is an example of the shift schedule, providing a clear understanding of the work hours and rotation you can expect in this role:
 
 

• Week X: You will work the early shift (06:15 – 14:15) from Monday to Friday. 

• Week X+1: You work the night shift (21:45 – 06:30) from Monday to Friday. 

• Week X+2: You work the late shift (14:00 – 22:00) from Monday to Wednesday, on Thursday and Friday you have recuperation and on Saturday and Sunday you work 12h - (06:30 – 18:30)  

• Week X+3: From Monday to Wednesday, you have recuperation and on Thursday and Friday you work in the late shift (14:00 – 22:00). 

• Week X: You work from Monday to Friday in the early shift. (06:15 – 14:15).

We guarantee that you won’t be bored
 

As a process operator, you have several responsibilities: 
 
 

• You will receive an intensive training before coordinating and operating high-end devices in the clean room. 

• You organize your own workload according to defined goals. 

• You are responsible for the quality of your own processing. 

• You perform quality tests meticulously. 

• You accurately report problems to our engineers.  

• You have a keen eye for safety and operational efficiency. 

• You suggest improvements.  

Who are we looking for?
 

Well, an enthusiastic personality and a passion for technology already go a long way. You are hands-on, full of expectation and eager to prove yourself. You enjoy working in a team, are accurate, dare to take initiative and are not afraid of asking questions. You have fluent communication skills in English. You are not looking for a typical nine-to-five and you see the advantages of working in shifts every now and again — handsome bonusses and lots of quality time on your hands while others are ‘insanely busy’. An example of our shift regime:
 
 

• Week X: You will work the early shift from Monday to Friday. 

• Week X+1: You work the night shift from Monday to Friday. 

• Week X+2: You work the late shift from Monday to Wednesday, on Thursday and Friday you have recuperation and on Saturday and Sunday you work 12h. 

• Week X+3: From Monday to Wednesday you have recuperation and on Thursday and Friday you work in the late shift. 

• Week X: You work from Monday to Friday in the early shift.

This is a unique opportunity for you to join as an Airbus First Officer on an enhanced salary package with an accelerated command upgrade scenario.
 
 

• You will need to operate the right-hand seat for a minimum of 700 stick hours and successfully complete two Evidence Based Training (EBT) recurrent training modules. 

• Assuming you meet the standards and display the required level of performance, you will then be eligible for accelerated command via an assessment process and an upgrade course. 

To join our Accelerated Command program, you will need the following experience:
 
 

• Minimum of 5,000 hours total flying time (excluding P3, rotary and single/multi-engine piston aircraft) 

• Minimum of 2,000 hours command time on Boeing/ Airbus FBW types 

• Minimum 1,000 hours command time on Airbus FBW 

• Airbus FBW type flown within the past 3 years 

• Minimum 150 hours in past 12 months on Airbus FBW/Boeing 

• Valid ICAO ATPL with matching Authority Class 1 Medical 

• ICAO English Level 5 or above  

*Airbus FBW excludes A220

Are you a motivated and technically proficient pilot who delivers excellence?
 

We’re looking for Direct Entry Captains to join our growing team. To become one of our A350 or A380 Captains,
 
 

• you will need a minimum of 7,000 hours total flying time in multi-crew, multi-engine aircraft (only time in the operating seat of a turboprop and/or turbojet aircraft is counted; simulator time is excluded). 

Qualification
 

To become one of our Airbus Captains, you will need: 
 
 

• Minimum 7,000 hrs total flying time (excluding P3, rotary and single/multi-engine piston aircraft)  

• Minimum 150 hrs in past 12 months on Airbus FBW as a Captain  

• A valid ICAO ATPL with a matching Authority Class 1 Medical  

• ICAO English level 5 or above  

For A380:
 
 

• Minimum of 3,000 hours PIC on Airbus FBW wide-body (A330/A340/A350/A380) 

• You must currently be flying on Airbus FBW wide-body as a Captain   

For A350:
 
 

• Minimum of 3,000 hours PIC on any Airbus FBW (
A320/A330/A340/A350/A380) 

• You must currently be flying on Airbus FBW as a Captain   

*Airbus FBW excludes A220

For an international organization in Brussels, we are looking for an Executive Assistant who wants to make an impact at executive level and contribute to strategic decision-making. Are you a true trusted advisor with a hands-on mindset? Apply today.
 

Your responsibilities as Executive Assistant
 

 
• You prepare executive and management meetings, including agendas, presentations, and strategic briefing notes
 
• You support and monitor the follow-up of business reviews and strategic action points
 
• You act as a key liaison between senior stakeholders, ensuring alignment at executive level
 
• You develop and structure strategic presentations, notes, and key messages
 
• You translate complex business information into clear insights and priorities, in close collaboration with the Personal Assistant 

Your profile as Senior Executive Assistant
 

 
• You have experience as an Executive Assistant at senior or C-level within a corporate environment
 
• You are highly organised and able to set priorities with ease
 
• You work proactively, in a structured and autonomous way
 
• You are discreet and able to handle sensitive information with confidentiality
 
• You have an excellent command of Dutch and English, with a good knowledge of French

We are looking for an 
Office & Event Assistant to strengthen our medical communication and education team
 
 

• Do you want to support, from the logistical and administrative side, a highly functioning team of colleagues that translate scientific data into impactful medical communication and education? 

• Are you an enthusiastic and dedicated team player with a hands-on mentality?

Job description
You will support the team and company by coordination of logistical or administrative tasks related to the office or projects 

For the office, you keep an eye on general tasks including office supplies/general vendors, you organise internal team meetings, and you support filing in the library system 

On event projects, you provide logistical and administrative support to the teams that develop medical communication and education for clients or for sponsors, e.g. booking flights, searching venues, supporting at the registration desk of (inter)national events, managing the registration portal, assisting with event email communication, coordinating material printing and shipments, etc

The administrative tasks related to both office and event entail data filing (contacts and vendors), and handling of sales invoices and expenses as a back-up 

Infrequent travel (within Belgium and abroad) is required. There is flexibility in working hours but an office attendance of minimally 3 days is required.

About Ismar Healthcare and e-HIMS
Ismar Healthcare is an independent medical communication and education agency based in Lier, Belgium. We offer high-quality ‘tailor-made’ solutions for and in partnership with the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device industry.

For the past 25 years, we have steadily grown to a mid-sized full-service medical communication agency, highly valued by our customers and employees.

For more information: https://ismar.com/ 

e-HIMS, a sister company of Ismar Healthcare facilitates together with professional associations the development and dissemination of independent CME programmes applying the patented professional development method ‘Mirrors of Medicine’ (MiMe).

For more information: https://mirrorsmed.org/
